correction_2026_10_09: SEPARATOR CORRECTION, 2026-10-09. Every row in this file that spelled a binding `<callable>#<binding>` now spells it with `BINDING_SEP` as the family defines it — U+0000, written `\u0000` in JSON. The character was `#` until src/ast/types.ts commit c95c8485f ("the binding separator was `#` — a character nine lanes legitimately publish, so their claims were unverifiable"): `#` is a real key character in other lanes (a CSS id selector, a markdown label, an HCL address), so `verifyBindingClaim` had to reject every binding claim on a run that also published one. The edges, their lines, their confidence and their metadata are UNCHANGED; only the separator character moved. Measured before this correction: `npx tsx script/m14/run-fixtures.ts --lang dart` -> {"dart":{"pass":21,"fail":7}}, and all 7 failures were rows whose sole difference was this character. Any `#` still visible in this file's prose is the 2026-10-08 spelling quoted as history, not the current one.
correction_2026_10_08: Two member-read targets moved from the bare leaf to `Store.count` because the read is inside Store and Store declares `count`. Deliberately NOT qualified: reads through a receiver whose declared type this pass does not read (the interpreter does not invent a spelling it cannot check). Reads of names the enclosing function BINDS moved to `<callable>#<binding>` instead — helper#x, compute#k, sums#i, blocks#p, inits#b and the rest — because a binding is not a declaration and the store resolves a target by STRING: the bare form bound to any single declaration carrying that name in the project. That is a third spelling, not a variant of the other two, and the fixture states which rows get which.
rationale: Dart second review (DT2): bound locals/params read as values (OC-E parity, exact scope resolution at 0.9), file-scope values read (globals + top-level functions), for-in/pattern/catch/lambda bindings, constructor-initializer params, cascade receivers. Labels, writes, declaration sites and type positions never read. Every pin probe-verified against both the analyzer and deriveDartBareUses before pinning; lanes confirm the pair agrees on corpora.
